start_here: Say to your AI: "Build option x05-r4-1 of my film in /films/made-up-film on its own copy of the project and export its preview; show me the plan first." It writes a request file, runs it with plan true, then for real.

lists.label: Settings
lists.holds: One row per tool and scope (a person, a film, a piece or the whole account): the settings that tool reads when it runs, as JSON.

instructions: 1. Pour the two example setting rows into your own settings list (see pour) and fill the film's row with a preview object: chapters, lock, export and loudness.
2. Put the option's spec at <chapter folder>/specs-round-<n>/<option>.json and the chapter's base-graded-copy.fcproj beside it.

3. Say what you said in start_here. Your AI reads the row with tools:list, writes request.json and runs `python3 tools/put-picked-options-into-a-filmcraft-project/do-work/filmcraft_preview.py /films/made-up-film/request.json` with plan true first.
4. Read the last JSON line: the project, the preview and its still land in work-round-<n>/pending/. Publish it with tool:publish-a-checked-filmcraft-preview once it is checked.

worked_examples.title: Option x05-r4-1 is built on its own copy of the project
worked_examples.ask: Build option x05-r4-1 of my film on its own copy and export its preview.
worked_examples.given: From tools/put-picked-options-into-a-filmcraft-project/test/test_filmcraft_preview.py, run for real with its made-up film and stand-in filmcraft-cli, ffmpeg and ffprobe (test/preview_world.py). The spec specs-round-4/x05-r4-1.json is {"id":"x05-r4-1","still_at":40.0,"duration_s":6.0,"edit":{"cuts":[[80.0,81.5]],"overlay":{"at":44.0},"preview":[38.0,58.0]}}; the settings are preview.chapters.one {options_folder: cuts/options-one, option_ids: ^x} and preview.lock.file cuts/.render.lock. The AI runs `python3 tools/put-picked-options-into-a-filmcraft-project/do-work/filmcraft_preview.py /films/made-up-film/request.json` with request.json = {"film":"/films/made-up-film","option":"x05-r4-1","settings":{...}}. With "plan": true the answer also lists in order: mkdir, copy of the base project, filmcraft-cli --save run (sequence.addEditAllTracks, edit.rippleDelete, file.import, timeline.place, clip.fillFrame), export --format h264 --start 38.0 --end 58.0 --scale 0.5 --quality 70, a two-pass loudnorm (I=-15, TP=-1.5, LRA=11) and the still.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
